name: Ambergris Cay - All Inclusive
positioning: All-inclusive private island resort of bungalows and villas in the Turks and Caicos
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive private island stay
Families or groups wanting a villa

facts.text: Ambergris Cay is a private island in the Turks and Caicos, on the southeast corner of the Turks and Caicos Islands, 600 miles south of Miami.
Guests have access to over 1,100 acres of mostly untouched land.
Guests choose between beachfront bungalows along the shore, waterside bungalows with direct calm-water access near the Club House, or privately owned homes and luxury villas.
The Waterside Bungalows have modern Caribbean design with floor-to-ceiling glass.
Every stay is all-inclusive, covering gourmet dining, premium spirits and cocktails, non-motorized water sports, yoga, electric bikes and tennis with a pro.
Dining settings include poolside bites, deserted beach picnics and all-day dining at Calico restaurant and bar.
Columbus Beach is an Atlantic Coast surf beach.
Monck Beach is a Caribbean Coast swimming beach.
The island's narrow, unpaved dirt roads are meant to prevent development that damages fragile ecosystems.
Elevate Spa offers massages and facials, and massages can be taken in air-conditioned oceanfront cabanas.
The Club House has an Explorer's Hut for kids from 5 years old, with interactive games and treasure hunts.
Each bungalow and villa has an Island Host.

highlights.text: Each Waterside Bungalow has a private heated plunge pool, a shaded terrace opening directly onto the water, and a kayak and paddleboard at the shore.
Marine activities include kayaking through mangroves, whale watching trips, free diving for conch and bone fishing.
Ambergris Cay has its own airstrip, purpose-built for seamless arrivals.
Dream Estate is the largest villa on Ambergris Cay, with two private chefs and butlers, four heated swimming pools and its own private beach.
The Hangover Tiki Bar is the island's floating bar, anchored in the turquoise shallows and reached by boat.

considerations.text: Spa treatments, motorized water sports including fishing and boat excursions, the reserve wine list, room service and private chef and dining services are not included.
Guests arriving in South Caicos must arrive by 4:00 p.m. to make the daytime flight connection to the island.
Resort casual is recommended for dinner.
